title: Two Famous Places
text:
The Statue of Liberty is in New York, in the United States. It is a big statue of a woman. It is green because it is made of copper. Many people take a boat to see it.

The Pyramids are in Egypt. They are very old, about 4,500 years old. Some of them are very big. People from all over the world come to see them.

questions.text: Where is the Statue of Liberty?
Why would a person need a boat to visit the Statue of Liberty?
options: It is far from the land and is in the water
It is in a big hotel

questions.text: Why do people come from all over the world to see the Pyramids?
options: Because the Pyramids are famous and special
Because the Pyramids are in their home countries

vocabulary.definition: a large figure of a person or animal made of stone or metal
very large buildings with a triangle shape and a square base

paragraph_translations: Özgürlük Heykeli Amerika Birleşik Devletleri'nde, New York'tadır. Bir kadının büyük bir heykelidir. Bakırdan yapıldığı için yeşildir. Birçok insan onu görmek için bir tekneye biner.
Piramitler Mısır'dadır. Çok eskidirler, yaklaşık 4.500 yıllıktırlar. Bazıları çok büyüktür. Dünyanın her yerinden insanlar onları görmeye gelir.
